plugins.name: readit
plugins.description: Turn any codebase into a readable book — chapters, flows, and diagrams — so people understand what's actually happening instead of vibe coding.

skills.name: codebase-book
skills.description: Methodology for turning a codebase into a complete, reference-grade book that lets a reader answer any internal design or implementation question without re-reading the source. Use when the user wants to deeply document, explain, or onboard people to a codebase — e.g. "make a book of this repo", "explain how this codebase works", or the /book command.
headings: Phase 1 — Coverage map (guarantee nothing is skipped)
Phase 2 — Outline (design the Table of Contents)
Techniques that make the book answer-complete

commands.name: book
commands.description: Generate a complete, reference-grade "book" of the current codebase — deep enough to answer any design or implementation question without re-reading the source.
